items.markdown:
To reduce or get rid of crow's feet (fine lines and wrinkles at the outer corners of the eyes), you can `use a combination of daily skincare, lifestyle changes, and professional medical treatments`.[[1]](https://perfectskinstudio.co.uk/blog/best-treatment-for-crows-feet/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=516gGtZga8I&t=32)

### At-Home Skincare & Preventative Habits

- **Apply Broad-Spectrum Sunscreen:** Daily SPF (30 or higher) protects the delicate skin around your eyes from ultraviolet (UV) radiation and photoaging. Wearing sunglasses also helps prevent squinting, which deepens expression lines.[[1]](https://www.eucerin.co.uk/skin-concerns/ageing-skin/crows-feet)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=516gGtZga8I&t=32)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7KMNQofAuBo&t=17)
- **Use Targeted Topicals:** 
	- **Retinol or Retinoids:** Encourage cell turnover and boost collagen production to smooth fine lines.
	- **Peptides and Vitamin C:** Help firm the skin and fight free radical damage. Options include [The Ordinary Multi-Peptide Eye Serum Go to product viewer dialogue for this item.](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:48,mid:576462741665863616,imageDocid:8736013232756066831,gpcid:14130735510744469954,headlineOfferDocid:7811677000068217329,catalogid:3469811344302208356,productDocid:5346976604964522649,rds:CSS_PC_14130735510744469954%7CPC_14130735510744469954%7CPROD_CSS_PC_14130735510744469954%7CPROD_PC_14130735510744469954&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwiR0ZmS1KyXAxWXT1UIHaMfEF8Qxa4PegoIAggACAAINRAB) or [CeraVe Skin Renewing Eye Cream Go to product viewer dialogue for this item.](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:48,imageDocid:12885474346098914967,gpcid:12388755007248636260,headlineOfferDocid:12851836821963467049,catalogid:16774114226503074692,productDocid:8217266061163918771,rds:CSS_PC_12388755007248636260%7CPC_12388755007248636260%7CPROD_CSS_PC_12388755007248636260%7CPROD_PC_12388755007248636260&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwiR0ZmS1KyXAxWXT1UIHaMfEF8Qxa4PegoIAggACAAINRAD).[[1]](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/diseases/24586-crows-feet)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:5346976604964522649,catalogid:3469811344302208356,gpcid:14130735510744469954,mid:576462741665863616&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://www.sknclinics.co.uk/conditions/crows-feet)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=516gGtZga8I&t=32)[[5]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:8217266061163918771,catalogid:16774114226503074692,gpcid:12388755007248636260&ibp=oshop)
- **Keep Skin Hydrated:** Use a dedicated, gentle eye cream or moisturizer with ceramides, hyaluronic acid, or caffeine to plump the area and reduce the look of crepey skin.[[1]](https://www.nivea.co.uk/articles/concerns/ageing/how-to-get-rid-of-crows-feet)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:8217266061163918771,catalogid:16774114226503074692,gpcid:12388755007248636260&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=516gGtZga8I&t=32)
- **Quit Smoking:** Tobacco smoke damages collagen, elastin, and skin structure, accelerating premature wrinkles.[[1]](https://www.sknclinics.co.uk/conditions/crows-feet)
- **Get Adequate Sleep:** Aim for 7 to 9 hours of quality rest each night to help your skin repair itself.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=516gGtZga8I&t=32)

### In-Office & Dermatological Treatments
For more pronounced or stubborn lines, professional procedures provide the fastest and most noticeable results:[[1]](https://perfectskinstudio.co.uk/blog/best-treatment-for-crows-feet/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=516gGtZga8I&t=32)

- **Botulinum Toxin (Botox / Dysport):** The gold standard for dynamic crow's feet (lines that appear when you smile or squint). It temporarily relaxes the underlying *orbicularis oculi* muscle to stop the skin from creasing. Results last about 3 to 4 months.[[1]](https://www.moderndermky.com/blog/how-to-fix-crows-feet-around-the-eyes)[[2]](https://perfectskinstudio.co.uk/blog/best-treatment-for-crows-feet/)
- **Dermal Fillers:** Hyaluronic acid fillers can be used if your lines are static (visible even at rest) due to volume loss around the eye pocket.[[1]](https://perfectskinstudio.co.uk/blog/best-treatment-for-crows-feet/)[[2]](https://www.moderndermky.com/blog/how-to-fix-crows-feet-around-the-eyes)
- **Laser Resurfacing & Microneedling:** Treatments like fractional lasers (e.g., Fraxel) or radiofrequency microneedling create micro-injuries in the skin to deep-stimulate new collagen and elastin remodeling.[[1]](https://www.sknclinics.co.uk/conditions/crows-feet)[[2]](https://perfectskinstudio.co.uk/blog/best-treatment-for-crows-feet/)
- **Chemical Peels:** Light-to-medium chemical peels (such as glycolic acid) remove damaged surface skin cells and improve overall eye-area texture.[[1]](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/diseases/24586-crows-feet)[[2]](https://perfectskinstudio.co.uk/blog/best-treatment-for-crows-feet/)

Consult a qualified dermatologist or aesthetic practitioner to evaluate whether dynamic relaxers or collagen-stimulating treatments fit your skin type.[[1]](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/diseases/24586-crows-feet)[[2]](https://perfectskinstudio.co.uk/blog/best-treatment-for-crows-feet/)If you'd like, let me know:

- Are your crow's feet **mostly visible when you smile/squint** or **visible all the time at rest**?
- What **skincare products** are you currently using around your eyes?

I can help you build a more tailored routine or discuss which treatments match your goals.
